options.name: allow_multiple_mappings
options.description: Specifies whether to allow or not allow multiple mappings. If the volume is mapped to one SDC then for every new mapping I(allow_multiple_mappings) has to be passed as true.

options.name: auto_snap_remove_type
options.description: Whether to remove or detach the snapshot policy. To remove/detach snapshot policy, empty I(snapshot_policy_id)/I(snapshot_policy_name) is to be passed along with I(auto_snap_remove_type). If the snapshot policy name/id is passed empty then I(auto_snap_remove_type) is defaulted to C(detach).

options.name: cap_unit
options.description: The unit of the volume size. It defaults to 'GB'.

options.name: delete_snapshots
options.description: If C(true), the volume and all its dependent snapshots will be deleted. If C(false), only the volume will be deleted. It can be specified only when the I(state) is C(absent). It defaults to C(false), if not specified.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: protection_domain_id
options.description: The ID of the protection domain. During creation of a volume, if more than one storage pool exists with the same name then either protection domain name or id must be mentioned along with it. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_name).

options.name: protection_domain_name
options.description: The name of the protection domain. During creation of a volume, if more than one storage pool exists with the same name then either protection domain name or id must be mentioned along with it. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_id).

options.name: refresh_src_vol_id
options.description: ID of the source volume/snapshot to refresh from. Either the name or the id of the source volume/snapshot is required Mutually exclusive with I(refresh_src_vol_name).

options.name: refresh_src_vol_name
options.description: Name of the source volume/snapshot to refresh from. Either the name or the id of the source volume/snapshot is required Mutually exclusive with I(refresh_src_vol_id).

options.name: restore_src_vol_id
options.description: ID of the source volume/snapshot to restore from. Either the name or the id of the source volume/snapshot is required Mutually exclusive with I(restore_src_vol_name).

options.name: restore_src_vol_name
options.description: Name of the source volume/snapshot to restore from. Either the name or the id of the source volume/snapshot is required Mutually exclusive with I(restore_src_vol_id).

options.name: sdc
options.description: Specifies SDC parameters.

options.name: sdc_state
options.description: Mapping state of the SDC.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the volume. Size of the volume will be assigned as higher multiple of 8 GB.

options.name: snapshot_policy_id
options.description: ID of the snapshot policy. To remove/detach snapshot policy, empty I(snapshot_policy_id)/I(snapshot_policy_name) is to be passed along with I(auto_snap_remove_type).

options.name: snapshot_policy_name
options.description: Name of the snapshot policy. To remove/detach snapshot policy, empty I(snapshot_policy_id)/I(snapshot_policy_name) is to be passed along with I(auto_snap_remove_type).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the volume.

options.name: storage_pool_id
options.description: The ID of the storage pool. Either name or the id of the storage pool is required for creating a volume. Mutually exclusive with I(storage_pool_name).

options.name: storage_pool_name
options.description: The name of the storage pool. Either name or the id of the storage pool is required for creating a volume. During creation, if storage pool name is provided then either protection domain name or id must be mentioned along with it. Mutually exclusive with I(storage_pool_id).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vol_id
options.description: The ID of the volume. Except create operation, all other operations can be performed using I(vol_id). Mutually exclusive with I(vol_name).

options.name: vol_name
options.description: The name of the volume. Mandatory for create operation. It is unique across the PowerFlex array. Mutually exclusive with I(vol_id).

options.name: vol_new_name
options.description: New name of the volume. Used to rename the volume.

options.name: vol_type
options.description: Type of volume provisioning.
